FX.title: [USD/JPY] UP: Technical Structure Holds Above MA20 Amid Yield Divergence and Geopolitical Hedging
tldr_points: USD/JPY maintains bullish posture above the 20-day moving average at 157.89.
RSI at 58.99 indicates robust momentum with room for further upside before overbought conditions.
Geopolitical headlines regarding Iran and Trump introduce tactical safe-haven flows, but yield differentials favor USD accumulation.
FX.excerpt: USD/JPY holds bullish structure above MA20. RSI at 58.99 supports tactical long positioning.
FX.comment: USD/JPY holds bullish structure above MA20 at 157.89, with RSI momentum at 58.99 supporting tactical long positioning.

CRYPTO.title: [BTC/USD] DOWN: AI Detects Resistance at MA20 as Fundamentals Turn Bearish
tldr_points: MSCI rule changes threaten crypto treasury inclusion, adding regulatory headwinds.
September mining output slips at CleanSpark and BitFuFu, signaling weaker on‑chain supply growth.
Price sits below MA20 with RSI near 40, indicating bearish momentum and a test of the 80k‑82k support zone.

CRYPTO.comment: BTC/USD trades below MA20 with RSI near 40, bearish bias amid regulatory and mining headwinds.
